### Step 1 — Scene
A mixed meal of seasoned rice, sliced cooked chicken, a roasted potato, leafy salad with avocado and other vegetables, and a round of corn on the cob.

### Step 2 — Vessel
A large, roughly square dinner plate, partly cropped. I’ll use an equivalent circular diameter of **26 cm**, giving an area of **3.14 × 13² ≈ 531 cm²**.

### Steps 3–7 — Items, area, volume, weight and energy
Areas are approximate, assigning overlapping foods to separate footprints to avoid double-counting. Cooking oil appears incorporated into the seasoned foods; their energy densities include it.

| Item | Plate area | Area × height = gross volume | Bulk density | Estimated grams | kcal/100 g | kcal |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Seasoned rice | 18% | 96 × 2 = 192 ml | 0.8 | 154 | 170 | 262 |
| Cooked chicken slices | 12% | 64 × 1.8 = 115 ml | 0.95 | 109 | 190 | 207 |
| Roasted potato | 7% | 37 × 2 = 74 ml | 0.95 | 70 | 130 | 91 |
| Corn round | 7% | 37 × 2.5 = 93 ml | 0.6 | 56 | 96 | 54 |
| Loose spinach/salad leaves | 24% | 127 × 2 = 254 ml | 0.15 | 38 | 23 | 9 |
| Avocado pieces | 3% | 16 × 1.5 = 24 ml | 0.6 | 14 | 160 | 22 |
| Other vegetables, including broccoli and tomato | 2% | 11 × 1.5 = 17 ml | 0.6 | 10 | 35 | 4 |

**Coverage check:** 18 + 12 + 7 + 7 + 24 + 3 + 2 = **73%**, consistent with the substantial empty area on the left. Corn weight is an approximate edible-kernel estimate, excluding the cob.

### Step 8 — Sanity check
The estimate is **about 450 g of edible food and 650 kcal**. This is plausible for the visible rice-and-chicken portion, small potato, corn round and loose salad. Cropping and uncertain cooking fat make the estimate approximate.
